definitions.explanation: The sound a phone or app plays to signal an incoming notification. {通知|つうち} (notification) + {音|おん} (sound).

examples.japanese: {通知音|つうちおん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧。
⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通知音|つうちおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
examples.english: The email notification sound went off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議中|かいぎちゅう}→会議中：16781_kaigichuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{通知音|つうちおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}らない→鳴る：01143_naru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I set it so that notification sounds don't play during meetings.

notes:
⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧ (notification) + {音|おん} (sound). Refers to the alert tone played by a phone or app.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通知音|つうちおん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧: to mute the notification sound
- {通知音|つうちおん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧: to change the notification tone
- {通知音|つうちおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧: the notification sound plays
